subject: Rapid safeguard deploy: short-notice runtime adjustments for memory hotspots
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jared Miller <jared.miller@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments SRE <sre@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T02:15:00Z
Subject: Rapid safeguard deploy required - short notice

Jared — we just surfaced an elevated memory-growth signature on your production inference cluster that, under the current traffic spike, pushes a small subset of pods toward OOM. This is a narrow, reproducible condition tied to a kernel scheduling interaction with our large-sequence KV-cache hotpath.

After a fast triage with runtime, infra, and your SRE on the call, we recommend a rapid safeguard deploy: a small runtime adjustment that reduces in-memory KV cache retention in-flight for 10-15 minutes and enables an automated eviction threshold. The change is low-risk (no model weights touched), reversible, and we've validated it on a staging replica. Expected impact: brief CPU spike during rollout, no persistent downtime; per-shard latency may increase +20-40ms during the window.

Planned approach (high level):
- 02:45 UTC: drain new connections to one shard and apply patch to runtime process
- 02:47–03:00 UTC: monitor errors/latency, then continue rolling across shards (target 10–15 min total)
- Auto-fallback: if 5xx > 1% or error rate spikes for 3 consecutive monitoring windows, automatically roll back to previous runtime variant and notify.

I’ve attached the ops runbook and the patch diff (text). We need explicit go/no-go from Acme SRE for a 02:45 UTC start. If you approve, our team will handle sequencing and post-deploy validation logs.

Regards,
Marcus
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops-runbook-safeguard-20280620.pdf (runbook), safeguard_patch.diff (text diff)

From: Jared Miller <jared.miller@acme-payments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Payments SRE <sre@acme-payments.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T02:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Rapid safeguard deploy required - short notice

Marcus — thanks for the quick triage + note. We are seeing the same elevated tail on our side and are comfortable with a rolling, reversible approach. A couple quick asks before you start:
- Exact start time in UTC (we have automated deploy windows and want to sync alarms)
- Confirmation of the rollback path and expected time to restore if the safeguard triggers rollback
- Will you publish a short post-deploy verification checklist we can run from our side?

If you can start at 02:45 UTC that works for our on-call. Go ahead after you confirm the rollback plan.

—Jared
SRE Manager, Acme Payments

On Tue, 20 Jun 2028 at 02:15, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jared — we just surfaced an elevated memory-growth signature on your production inference cluster...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jared Miller <jared.miller@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments SRE <sre@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T02:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Rapid safeguard deploy required - short notice

Jared — quick technical confirmation and rollback details below. Thanks for approving the start time. We'll begin at 02:45 UTC.

What we’re applying:
- A runtime binary flag flip that reduces KV-cache retention window and forces more-aggressive prefix compaction for in-flight entries (text-only patch; no model reload).
- Small instrumentation change to tag affected requests for easier log filtering.

Rollback path if triggered:
- Immediate orchestration triggers a sequential restore to the prior runtime variant per shard (same process, reverse flag).
- Full restore timeframe: worst-case 6 minutes per shard; for the cluster size here we expect <20 minutes to fully restore across all shards if we roll back.

Post-deploy verification checklist for your SREs (short):
1) Check per-shard 95/99 latency — should return to baseline within 10 minutes of completion.
2) Confirm no increase in 5xx beyond 0.5% baseline.
3) Inspect request tags: "kv-sg-flag" present and logs show compaction events.
4) Run spot load test on a staging proxy (optional) — instructions in runbook.

We will stream logs to the ticket and leave a 30-minute monitoring hold after the final shard completes. If you want us to run an automated rollback on your behalf if thresholds breach, let us know and we will enable it.

—Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops-runbook-safeguard-20280620.pdf

On Tue, 20 Jun 2028 at 02:23, Jared Miller <jared.miller@acme-payments.com> wrote:

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jared Miller <jared.miller@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments SRE <sre@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T06:40:00Z
Subject: Rapid safeguard deploy - completion and next steps

Jared / Acme SRE — closing the loop from Redwood side. We completed the rolling safeguard deploy and held monitoring. Summary:
- Start: 02:45 UTC; full roll completed by 03:05 UTC.
- Observed: transient increase in CPU on first shard (+18%), median latency unchanged; 95/99 returned to baseline within 8 minutes of completion.
- No increase in 5xx beyond baseline thresholds.
- We left the flag in the safer position for 24 hours and have scheduled a targeted follow-up tomorrow to evaluate a non-invasive parameter tune for longer-term stability.

Attachments (in thread): ops-runbook-safeguard-20280620.pdf, safeguard_patch.diff.

Action items:
- Redwood: collect extended heap/trace logs for the affected pods and attach to INC-38472 by EOD UTC. (Assigned: Marcus, Rishi)
- Acme: run the short verification checklist (Rishi's list) and post results to the ticket; if you prefer we can run the checklist and share the results.
- Follow-up sync: 2028-06-21 14:00 UTC for post-mortem + next-step tuning. Calendar invite to follow.

Thanks for the quick coordination — appreciate the patience on a short notice change.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
